decisions.reason: The custom in-ear earmold builds directly on the firm's long earmold and hearing-system expertise, its in-house labs, and its digital production know-how, so the firm can read early results and refine the product, though its thinner web presence leaves some risk that it is folded into other offers.

The individual EARsleeve for universal in-ear hearing systems has its own web page and sits at the core of the firm's earmold knowledge base, so the firm is well placed to absorb customer feedback and improve it.

The vacuum thermoforming unit extends the firm's established dental equipment and materials system, where in-house R&D and long experience let it integrate and improve the device within its workflow offering.
